title: Realized versus Population Reliability: Anytime-Valid Self-Consistency Certification under Correlated Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.26592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-consistency certification treats repeated sampling from a language model as sequential evidence accumulation and stops when an anytime-valid e-process crosses a threshold, guaranteeing finite-sample Type I error control by Ville's inequality. Prior constructions assume sampled rollouts are conditionally independent. We show this assumption fails in practice: reasoning streams are positively correlated through shared reasoning prefixes or across-prompt heterogeneity, changing not merely certificate efficiency but the hypothesis certified. Modeling dependence via a per-unit latent state (the random-effects / intraclass-correlation structure) induces exchangeable, equi-correlated increments with correlation $\rho$. Correlation splits the single null into a realized null about the drawn belief and a population null about average model behavior, which coincide only when $\rho=0$. translated_title: 实现可靠性与总体可靠性之辨：相关推理下任意时刻有效的自一致性认证
translated_abstract: 自一致性认证将语言模型的重复采样视为序贯证据累积过程，当任意时刻有效的 e-process 越过阈值时停止，并借助 Ville 不等式保证有限样本下的第一类错误控制。以往构造假设采样的 rollout 是条件独立的。我们证明该假设在实践中并不成立：推理流会因共享推理前缀或跨提示异质性而呈正相关，这不仅改变证书的效率，更改变了所认证的假设本身。通过引入每单元潜变量（随机效应/组内相关结构）对依赖性建模，可得到可交换、等相关的增量，其相关系数为 ρ。相关性将单一零假设分裂为关于所抽取信念的“实现零假设”与关于模型平均行为的“总体零假设”，二者仅在 ρ=0 时重合。我们证明：(i) 标准投注 e-process 仍保持任意……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现语言模型推理流之间存在正相关，破坏了自一致性认证所依赖的条件独立假设，使被认证的假设分裂为关于单次抽取信念的“实现零假设”与关于模型平均行为的“总体零假设”（仅在零相关时二者等价），从而从根本上改变了 anytime-valid 证书所真正保证的可靠性含义。
en_tdlr: Correlated reasoning streams violate the conditional-independence assumption behind anytime-valid self-consistency certification, splitting the certified hypothesis into a realized null about the drawn belief and a population null about average model behavior, which coincide only when the correlation ρ equals zero.
